prompt:
Create a high-fidelity landscape desktop web app screenshot (1440 x 960, no browser chrome) for a real product catalogue CRUD tool used by both a student and instructor in an Advanced Databases demo. This is a working product data interface, not a poster, book cover, concept art, collage, or marketing page. No product photos, no logos, no invented IDs, dates, counts, metrics, stock values, category names, products, or fields.

Visual direction: “Reference Leaf”, inspired by a tabbed technical manual. Translate a manual’s practical hierarchy into a live record editor: a quiet section tab rail, one clearly active record, careful alignment, and a separate readable document view. Use a cool pale gray-green board #F4F6F3, deep ink #1B2930, strong cobalt-blue #235BE9 for the selected section and primary action, and a small archival yellow #F0C945 as an active marker. Workhorse sans-serif throughout with monospaced field values and JSON. Material cues should be limited to flat tab boards and a crisp white page leaf; no fake paper grain, no blur, no shadows, no serif, no cream, no terracotta.

The header contains only “Product catalogue”, a small “Sample data” indicator, and “Add product”. Below, arrange a searchable product index at left (about 43% width) and the open record leaf at right (about 57%). The left pane has labeled Search and Category controls and exactly these rows:
Samsung Galaxy A15 | Phones | ZMW 2,800 | Stock 14 | In stock
Tecno Spark 20 | Phones | ZMW 2,100 | Stock 22 | In stock
iPhone 13 | Phones | ZMW 11,500 | Stock 4 | Low stock
Cotton T-Shirt | Clothing | ZMW 150 | Stock 60 | In stock
Select Samsung Galaxy A15. No extra rows, IDs or counts.

The right leaf has a short section tab rail with “Product fields” and “MongoDB document”, with Product fields active and the document readout also visible below. Show an edit form with exact labeled fields and values: Name Samsung Galaxy A15; Category Phones; Price (ZMW) 2800; Stock 14; Tags android and budget; Specs storage 128GB, ram 4GB, battery 5000mAh. Show Save product, Cancel, Delete. Under the form show “MongoDB document” and a readable nested JSON object containing only name, category, price, stock, tags and specs with those exact values. No ObjectId and no timestamp. The record index and form must remain clearly visible as a practical CRUD interface. Crisp typography, precise tab geometry, strong contrast, no nested cards, no additional invented content.
